content.stem: 一家银行注意到由于缺乏标准化的支付消息格式,区块链交易的标记存在不一致的情况.在交易筛查工具中,应优先考虑哪项功能来解决此问题？

options.A: 对传统支付信息加强制裁筛查
options.B: 定期人工审查与区块链相关的交易
options.C: 与区块链分析提供商的集成
options.D: 基于规则的系统仅关注已知的钱包地址

content.stem_en: A bank notices inconsistent tagging of blockchain transactions due to the lack of standardized payment message formats. Which functionality should be prioritized in the transaction screening tool to address this issue?

options_en.A: Enhanced sanctions screening of traditional payment messages
options_en.B: Periodic manual review of blockchain-related transactions
options_en.D: Rule-based systems that focus only on known wallet addresses
